observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with a floor-to-ceiling mirror wall, gray draped curtains, a wall logo, a standing fan at the right, and a ballet barre visible in the mirror. A barefoot woman in a white tank top and pink trousers stands with her back to the camera, legs in a wide stance with one leg extended to the side and pointed, facing her own reflection (the figure on the left of the frame is the mirror image of the same dancer, not a second person). She is mid-movement throughout, performing an arm-and-torso sequence.
visible_changes: The arm that starts bent near the chest/face gradually lifts, arches over the head, and ends fully extended upward overhead.
The other arm, initially extended outward and downward to the side, moves down to rest near the hip, then later extends outward and upward to the side.
The torso tilts and leans laterally while the head tilts back as the overhead arm rises, forming a curved posture by the end.
The wide leg stance with the side leg extended and pointed is maintained; the hips/pelvis shift subtly but no foot is lifted or placed.
All of these changes are mirrored exactly in the reflection on the left, confirming a single dancer and not two figures.
outside_clip_unknowns: The excerpt begins and ends mid-sequence; the choreography before the first frame and after the last frame, any accompanying music or counts, and the completion of the movement are not shown.
uncertain_details: Exact left/right assignment of the two arms is ambiguous from the back view.
The camera appears essentially static (background cues such as curtains, logo, fan, and light do not shift), but a very minor framing adjustment cannot be fully ruled out.
